user_story: As a user, I want to manage records in a web table so that I can add, edit, or delete entries easily. Acceptance Criteria: 1. The user can click the 'Add' button (selector: '#addNewRecordButton') to open a form for adding a new record. 2. The user can input data and submit the form, which will add the new record to the web table. 3. The user can click on an existing record to edit it, make changes, and submit to update the record. 4. The user can delete a record from the table and verify that it no longer appears in the table. 5. If the user submits an empty form, the URL should not change and the table should remain unchanged.
